podcast.title: Superhero Costumes (1970)
podcast.body: In 1970, Hype, fronted by David Bowie, appeared in superhero-themed costumes, including shiny materials, thigh-high boots, and Bowie's "rainbow man" cape, distinguishing them from the prevalent hippie fashion. "They began appearing in interesting costumes. They all had superhero outfits made from shiny material and augmented by thigh-high boots."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
